items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution and has been actively exploited in the wild since September 4, 2026. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 before this update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1, arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of in-the-wild exploits for these specific issues.

items.title: Action Required: Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This vulnerability allows an attacker to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API and has entered active exploitation. Adobe released a hotfix (VULN-32437-2-4-X-patch) to remediate this issue.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. Sansec reported this vulnerability.

items.id: Mirasvit Cache Warmer PHP object injection
items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves important and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.
